microscopic_probe_items.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np, time
from model import conformation
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
rate,rot,T,L,d=.5,.2,1.,6.,4.1
n=10000; dt=2e-4; steps=100000
q=np.zeros((n,2)); k=np.array([[rate,-rot],[rot,-rate]])
s=np.sqrt(4*T/d*dt)
acc=[]; t0=time.time()
for it in range(steps):
 w=1-np.sum(q*q,axis=1)/L
 drift=q@k.T - (2/d)*q/w[:,None]
 q += dt*drift+s*rng.normal(size=q.shape)
 # rare numerical crossings: reject noise step (approx); reflect radius a little
 rr=np.sum(q*q,axis=1)
 bad=rr>=L
 if bad.any():
  q[bad]*=(np.sqrt(L)*(1-1e-10)/np.sqrt(rr[bad]))[:,None]
 if it>=50000 and it%100==0:
  w=1-np.sum(q*q,axis=1)/L
  acc.append(np.mean((q[:,0]**2-q[:,1]**2)/w))
print('time',time.time()-t0,'n',len(acc),'mean',np.mean(acc),'se',np.std(acc)/np.sqrt(len(acc)))
c,f=conformation(rate,rot,T,d,L); print('FENEP',f*(c[0,0]-c[1,1]))
PY"
